name: What is the process for installing outdoor kitchen plumbing?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing outdoor kitchen plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally begins with a site assessment to determine the best routing for water and drain lines, considering existing utilities and landscape. Next, trenches are dug, and pipes are laid for both water supply and drainage, ensuring proper slope for efficient wastewater removal. Connections are then made to your home's main water supply and sewer system. Finally, fixtures are installed and tested for leaks and proper function. We coordinate with any other contractors involved in your outdoor kitchen project to ensure a smooth installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves site assessment, trenching, laying pipes, connecting to home utilities, and installing fixtures. We coordinate with other contractors for a smooth process.
